changelog: 1.0.33: sagas everywhere and from better clues — one volume per saga, the first one not yet seen, in every home row (not only "For you"); sagas are recognised from the movie's TMDb collection (a new part counts even before Jellyfin files it), from Jellyfin collections and from the name (a movie continuing a series comes after the series); collections that mix several TMDb collections (a director, "Marvel") are thematic groups, never a saga; a sequel whose start is missing from the library comes last; "Because you liked X" only starts from titles actually watched; a Jellyfin Like on a watchlisted title (Seerr / Jellyfin Enhanced watchlist) counts as an intent, not a review; the preview shows the real "For you" row and hides empty rows.
description: Personal recommendations that replace Jellyfin's own.
name: Reco+
overview: Personal recommendations (full history, abandoned titles, sagas, Seerr requests, extended mode).
